headline: Gochang Hwang Yunseok Library / Hyunjoon Yoo + Partners
context: Thanks to the digital environment, we can now easily access knowledge and information anytime, anywhere. So what significance do public libraries have today? They act as a living room for everyone, a place where anyone can stay, relax, and create memories for free.
